title: Lattice.Harbor.PAR2.MultiGrid.Overlap.Repair.2026.1080p.WEB-DL.H264-TESTGRP
description: One 96 MiB payload described by independent 64 KiB and 96 KiB PAR2 sets, with eight ranges of 128 KiB zeroed. The 64 KiB set holds four recovery blocks for its sixteen damaged slices and cannot rebuild the payload; the 96 KiB set holds twenty-four for its sixteen and must, so the payload is delivered byte for byte.
